scenarios.scenario: Tenant B reads/writes/deletes/imports tenant A's exclusion list
scenarios.rationale: verify_site_access on every route (404); delete WHERE site_id AND id. Proven by test_crud_foreign_site_404.

scenarios.scenario: Owner adds gmail.com or co.uk, excluding (or probing) everyone
scenarios.rationale: validate_exclusion_domain rejects freemail, public suffixes and <2-label entries (G1 + test_crud_rejects_freemail_and_suffix); matcher parent walk never yields a bare TLD.
file.read(MAX+1) caps bytes at 1MB+1 then 413; row cap 5000 (test_crud_import_too_large_413, test_csv_row_cap).
match is exact on the label-suffix walk; unit test asserts no match.

scenarios.scenario: Excluded person reached via merged/secondary visitor id
Approving an excluded draft auto-rejects siblings / saves voice example / leaves draft approved
scenarios.rationale: 409 raised before status change, sibling reject and voice save (test_flag_on_approve_excluded_draft_409 asserts still pending, send not called).
single log event carries site_id/surface/count only (test_should_log_counts_only); CRUD logs counts only.

scenarios.scenario: Flag OFF silently changes behavior or queries
scenarios.rationale: every call is inside `if settings.company_exclusion_enabled`; G4 patches helpers to raise and asserts no SQL touched site_exclusions; G7 AST census.
G7 census fails on any un-reviewed caller of the guarded chokepoints, but callers of entirely new send paths are only caught by review.
